function redefine(a: number) {
  Object.defineProperty(arguments, "0", { value: 5 });
  console.log(a, arguments[0]);
  a = 7;
  console.log(a, arguments[0]);
  Object.defineProperty(arguments, "0", { enumerable: false });
  a = 9;
  console.log(a, arguments[0]);
  Object.defineProperty(arguments, "0", { value: 11, writable: false });
  console.log(a, arguments[0]);
  a = 13;
  console.log(a, arguments[0]);
}
function remove(a: number) {
  delete arguments[0];
  Object.defineProperty(arguments, "0", { value: 5, writable: true });
  a = 7;
  console.log(a, arguments[0]);
}
function access(a: number) {
  Object.defineProperty(arguments, "0", { get() { return 5; } });
  a = 7;
  console.log(a, arguments[0]);
}
function frozen(a: number) {
  Object.freeze(arguments);
  a = 7;
  console.log(a, arguments[0]);
}
redefine(1);
remove(1);
access(1);
frozen(1);
